title: OFM property metadata
description: Payload of {property topic}/_meta. Published retained, republished only when the model changes (Architecture Overview §6.3). Cleared with an empty retained message when the property is renamed or retired (ADR-0004).

propertyId.description: Immutable property ID; joins UNS data with historian rows (hist.measurement.property_id).

datatype.description: Datatype of v in the live payload.

unit.description: Engineering unit code from config.engineering_unit (e.g. degC, bar, rpm, pct). Required for float and int.

low.description: Lower limit of the engineering range.

high.description: Upper limit of the engineering range.

maxPublishIntervalMs.description: Longest time between publications (ADR-0007). A value older than twice this interval is stale.
